test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 09 Oct, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

The new/ smartphone is/absolutely best than/ the latest model.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the incorrect use of the adjective "**best**" instead of the comparative form "**better**."
 
• Comparative adjectives are used to compare differences between the two objects they modify (larger, smaller, faster, higher).
 
• The correct phrase should be "**absolutely better than**," ensuring grammatical correctness and clarity.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 3** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The new smartphone is absolutely better than the latest model."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **1: "The new" **– This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **2: "smartphone is"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **4: "the latest model."** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **No error** – This would be the correct option if there were no mistakes in the sentence, but there is an error in part 3.
